name: update
title: menu:update
lead: New pictures in place, the menu left open: a bar that fills, a count that changes. `on_pick` still answers by position. `false` once the player has put it away; a Bedrock form keeps what it showed.

usedIn.quote: - `menu:update` returns `false` after the player closes the menu. Picks still answer by position. A Bedrock form keeps its first items.
